## What It Does

From ljagiello/ctf-skills repo: agent skills for CTF categories. ctf-crypto covers techniques from writeups (e.g. ai-ml: adversarial, jailbreaks, model extraction; pwn/reverse: binary; web: exploitation; etc). Includes scripts/ for env. MIT license stated, SECURITY.md with responsible use. Use only for authorized CTF/lab/security-research.

## Harness Coverage

Targets verified harnesses: `antigravity`, `claude-code`, `codex`, `crush`, `cursor`, `gemini-cli`, `github-copilot`, `grok`, `opencode`.

**Portable multi-harness install command:**
```bash
npx skills add ljagiello/ctf-skills --skill ctf-ai-ml --skill ctf-crypto --skill ctf-forensics --skill ctf-malware --skill ctf-misc --skill ctf-osint --skill ctf-pwn --skill ctf-reverse --skill ctf-web --skill ctf-writeup --skill solve-challenge -y -g -a antigravity claude-code codex crush cursor gemini-cli github-copilot grok opencode
```

## Trust / Audit

Trust tier: **Inspect first** (`needs-inspection`)

Curated status: `inspect-then-install`

Risk notes: Use `ljagiello/ctf-skills` only for authorized CTF, lab, and security-research work. Its audit found MIT licensing and responsible-use framing, but also offensive-security workflows, write-capable permissions, and a broad local installer that can invoke `pip`, `apt`, `brew`, `gem`, `go`, and possibly `sudo`; run the installer dry-run before executing it.

Entry maintained in authoring SSOT `docs/src/authoring/skills/ctf-crypto.mdx` and `docs/public/generated-registries/skills-catalog-index.json`; research context is advisory.

## Install Prerequisites

npx skills add ljagiello/ctf-skills --skill ctf-crypto ... ; or full group; pre-run installer dry-run; status=inspect-then-install.
